_howto: GMP is filled in by hand. Every IPO card on ipo-gmp.html shows an ID (e.g. ID: SAMPINFRA). Under 'gmp' write that ID and the GMP in rupees: "SAMPINFRA": 38 or "DEMOFOOD": -12 (use null if there is no GMP yet). If the page shows 'Lot Size: TBA', you can also give the lot: "MOCK-TEXTILES": {"gmp": 9, "lotSize": 2000}. Change 'updated' (IST time) every time you edit GMP. IPOs whose RHP is filed with SEBI appear on their own (tag: RHP filed). If the company has announced dates/price band before NSE/BSE list it, add the same company name under 'extraIpos' with open, close, priceLow, priceHigh, lotSize -- they fill in that card and are ignored once NSE/BSE list it. For an IPO not yet filed anywhere, an 'extraIpos' entry with "tentative": true and an "expected" text shows a Tentative card.
